d: At Optasia we use the latest technologies and tools to build impactful customer experiences, grow our network and provide comprehensive financial access for millions of customers in countries across continental Africa, Asia and beyond.

We are seeking a dynamic Employee Relations Leader who brings deep experience handling complex employee relations matters in fast-growing, international organizations, together with a practical understanding of how to balance pace, fairness, consistency, and risk in a growing post-IPO business.

The ideal person will combine strong international employee relations and employment law expertise with sound commercial judgement, excellent stakeholder management capability, and the ability to guide leaders through sensitive people issues with clarity and confidence
Experience advising across multiple jurisdictions including in Africa and Asia, leading large-scale workforce optimization programs and enabling business and organizational change
Coaching and upskilling leaders and managers on workforce change, adding to a culture of engaged and enabled people managers

This is a Senior team role in a growing business where delivering with confidence, pace, and sound judgement is essential, and where a go-getter spirit and customer orientation are valued as highly as technical excellence.
q: A credible, commercially minded Employee Relations leader who can operate as a trusted adviser to senior leaders and stakeholders while maintaining excellent operational grip on high-risk and sensitive casework.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, matrixed, multicultural business where priorities shift quickly, local market requirements vary, and balanced judgement is required on high-impact people matters.

Passionate about building fair, scalable and well-governed employee relations and people practices that protect the business, support growth, strengthen leadership capability, and create consistency across markets
Significant direct experience (8+ yrs) leading delivery of ER including at a regional level with experience of business partnering preferred
Extensive employee relations experience in international, high-growth, regulated, or complex business environments in Asia and Africa
Experience dealing with complex M&A, assessment & integration projects

Demonstrated capability in handling complex investigations, conduct matters, performance cases, grievances, redundancies, and other sensitive employee relations issues from initial assessment through to resolution.
Strong experience operating across multiple countries, with practical understanding of employee relations risk, employment practices, and the need to balance consistency with local compliance
Strong knowledge of employee relations risk, process discipline, and the importance of clear documentation, consistency, and defensible decision-making.
Data-informed, pragmatic, and business-oriented approach to solving people risk and workplace issues
Proven ability to build effective working relationships with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders including Legal, Compliance
Strong coaching and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge constructively and raise the quality of people decisions.
High levels of integrity, professionalism, discretion, and resilience when dealing with complex or high-pressure situations.
Ability to plan and prioritize work under tight deadlines, work on own initiative, and as a member of a team.

x: Optasia is a real-time financial intelligence company turning potential into financial progress.

Our AI-powered platform turns permitted behavioural data and real-time signals into precise, responsible credit decisions. It runs millions of automated decisions every day inside the systems of telcos, banks, digital wallets and other partners, across high-growth markets in Africa, Asia and the Middle East.

The work is demanding, and it matters. You’ll solve for limited formal credit data, unstable connectivity and informal incomes in live production, with risk tightly governed at every step. What you build helps people who were underrepresented in traditional credit histories get practical access to financial services.

We are listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE: OPA), with our head office in Dubai. Our Credo shapes how we work: we start with why, we walk the talk, and we work as One Tribe across teams, countries and cultures.
Flexible working, including our work-from-anywhere policy
Competitive pay and a performance-based bonus scheme
An extra day off on your birthday
The equipment you need to do your best work
Support for your well-being and your career growth
